mapper.sql: id, client_code, client_name, contract_code, contract_name, plan_date, rent_amount, principal_amount, interest_amount, principal_tax, interest_tax, outflow_amount, planned_interest, planned_principal, cash_flow, opening_amortized_cost, ending_amortized_cost, actual_daily_rate, rental_income, service_fee_amortization_rate, service_fee_amortization_income, xirr_rate, actual_repayment_date, actual_repayment_principal_balance, actual_repayment_principal_amount, actual_repayment_interes_balance, actual_repayment_interes_amount, recapture_status, overdue_earnings, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, source_irr_rate, adjustment_amount, change_after_ending_amortized_cost, change_after_ending_amortized_cost, impairment_third_stage
mapper.select: select contract_code, org_id, sum(coalesce(actual_repayment_principal_amount, 0)) as actual_repayment_principal_amount, sum(coalesce(actual_repayment_interes_amount, 0)) as actual_repayment_interes_amount from eg_repayment_plan where 1 = 1 and contract_code = #{param.contractCode} and org_id = #{param.orgId} and to_char(actual_repayment_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') <= to_char(to_date(#{param.planDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') group by contract_code, org_id

select contract_code, min(plan_date) as plan_date from eg_repayment_plan where del_flag = '0' and recapture_status != '2'
and contract_code in
#{item}
group by contract_code

select x.* from eg_repayment_plan x where 1 = 1 and x.actual_repayment_date is not null and to_char(x.actual_repayment_date, 'yyyy-MM-DD') = to_char(to_date(#{replaymentDate},'yyyy-MM-dd'),'yyyy-MM-dd') and x.contract_code = #{contractCode} order by x.id desc limit 1

select oai.contract_code as contractCode , coalesce(hy.cashFlowSum,0) as cashFlowSum, oai.end_balance_for oustandingAmount, oaia.end_balance_for residualValueAmount, (coalesce(hy.cashFlowSum,0) + (coalesce(oai.end_balance_for, 0) + coalesce(na.service_no_amortization_amout, 0))) * -1 as cashflowInit from ( select contract_code contractCode, sum(cash_flow) cashFlowSum from eg_repayment_plan where del_flag ='0' and plan_date > #{params.initDate} group by contract_code order by contract_code ) hy right join ( select contract_code, account_number, sum(end_balance_for) end_balance_for from eg_outstanding_amount_init where account_number in ('1532.01', '1505.03.02') and coalesce(end_balance_for, 0) != 0 group by contract_code , account_number ) oai on hy.contractCode = oai.contract_code left join eg_service_no_amortization na on na.contract_code = hy.contractCode left join ( select contract_code, account_number, sum(end_balance_for) end_balance_for from eg_outstanding_amount_init where account_number = '1531.01.03' group by contract_code , account_number ) oaia on hy.contractCode = oaia.contract_code where oai.contract_code is not null
and oai.contract_code = #{params.contractCode}
